lede: The most consequential meeting this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission on Thursday, where commissioners take up both a county-wide subdivision work session and an energy code update that would set new building standards for new construction — foundational stuff that rarely gets public attention but shapes development for years. Ridgway's Town Council also holds a public hearing Wednesday on the Hyde Subdivision replatting and a joint work session on its draft 2026 Housing Action Plan, while SMART's board votes on two resolutions restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee and professional assignments tied to the voter-approved $5.2M/year gondola tax project. The Mushroom Festival is running through the week if you need a reason to be outside.
